Shared scene geography, binding across the whole sequence: the same mountain path with forked pine, low rounded boulder and rocky bank from the clean stage reference. Father faces left toward son; son faces right toward father. Son turns his face away from the air line, cheek stays uninjured. Father lowers attacking hand by his reaction shot. Son touches that same RIGHT cheek with his RIGHT hand through protest and joke. He lowers the hand before following father. At the ending father leads along the same path, son follows several steps behind. Father never turns back during praise or thanks. Son looks ALONG the path toward father, not backward toward camera. Maintain soft daylight, clothing, ages, backpack and landmarks. No new people, weapon use, wounds or extra attacks. The faint air streak appears ONLY in the attack frame, nowhere else.
